subject.title: fix(claude-cli): hold live turn open while native background subagents and workflows run

question: After real gateway/channel proof is added, should OpenClaw accept the observed Claude CLI background-task event shape as the lifecycle contract for holding turns open?
rationale: The event behavior is supported by live probes and focused tests, but it is an upstream compatibility dependency whose long-term stability and failure policy require owner judgment.

options.title: Accept After Live Proof
options.body: Merge after exact-head channel proof and retain focused event-shape, delivery, watchdog, and timeout regression coverage.

options.title: Require Stable Upstream Contract
options.body: Pause the PR until Anthropic documents or otherwise stabilizes the background-task stream event contract or OpenClaw gains a safer fallback.

recommendation.title: Accept After Live Proof
recommendation.body: Merge after exact-head channel proof and retain focused event-shape, delivery, watchdog, and timeout regression coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: The sibling Codex lifecycle work makes this person the strongest available owner for the cross-runtime completion and cleanup decision.
